# 燃烧室与稳定性

_Combustors & Combustion Stability_

燃烧室在压气机和涡轮之间完成燃料与空气的混合及燃烧。基础阅读可从筒形、环形、环管形等构型入手，再了解稳定燃烧、压损和出口温度分布。

_The combustor mixes fuel and air between the compressor and turbine. Begin with can, annular and can-annular layouts, then examine stable burning, pressure loss and exit-temperature distribution._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 画出燃料、主燃空气和冷却空气的大致路径。

_Sketch the fuel, primary-air and cooling-air paths._

- 把点火、贫油熄火等问题与工作状态和试验条件一起记录。

_Record ignition and lean-blowout issues together with operating states and test conditions._

- 对照燃烧效率、压力损失和温度分布，理解各项指标之间的约束。

_Compare combustion efficiency, pressure loss and temperature distribution to understand competing requirements._
